name: isnady — all sources (default)
description: isnady's own repository: every hadith collection and rijal work isnady reads, Sunni and Shia, in one place and one format.

entries.title: Sahih al-Bukhari
entries.description: Compiled by al-Bukhari (d. 256). Arabic and 8 translations (English, Turkish, Urdu, Indonesian, Bengali, French, Russian, Tamil); graded by al-Albani, Shu'ayb al-Arna'ut, Zubair 'Ali Za'i and others where they graded it.

entries.title: Sahih Muslim
